items.title: IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation
items.summary: IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 2B, an Apache 2.0 speech recognition and translation model. It ranks #2 on the Open ASR Leaderboard with 5.68% average English WER, alongside updated Turbo CTC and 4.1 2B Plus models. The post IBM AI Releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B for Multilingual Transcription and Translation appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
items.summary: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: A Coding Guide to Cactus Whistle: Does a 16.9 MB Speech Model Hold Up Against Whisper Base? Word Error Rate, Speed, Streaming, Timestamps, Keywords, and Speech-to-Tool Calls on a CPU
items.summary: Explore a comprehensive coding guide benchmarking Cactus Compute's 16.9 MB speech model against Whisper base. items.title: NVIDIA Nsight Python Tutorial: How to Profile GPU Kernels
items.summary: Discover NVIDIA Nsight Python, an open-source interface that allows developers to profile GPU kernels, analyze hardware metrics, evaluate cache and clock controls, and measure kernel fusion directly from Python code. The post NVIDIA Nsight Python Tutorial: How to Profile GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params
items.summary: Recursive has released Flint, an Apache 2.0 local coding model with 40B total and 2.5B active parameters. It reports 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 125+ tokens per second on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro. The post Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents
items.summary: Vercel released durable-harness, an open-source package that logs every model and tool call so Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex sessions resume after crashes, timeouts and redeploys on Vercel, Postgres or a laptop. The post Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
items.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU, a Native PyTorch Backend for Cloud TPUs
items.summary: Google and Meta open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Cloud TPUs. It runs eager by default, compiles through torch.compile and XLA, and replaces PyTorch/XLA for new workloads. The post Google Open-Sources TorchTPU, a Native PyTorch Backend for Cloud TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
items.summary: DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the Apache 2.0 inference framework that serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in production. It targets NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, and ships offline inference only. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, the Inference Framework Behind DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost.
